summary: Describes Tree Engineering for Bit Index Explicit Replication (BIER-TE), which steers BIER multicast packets along strict or loose paths without per-flow state in the network. It gives the bit positions in the packet a new meaning, so they indicate adjacencies rather than destinations, and it serves as the path steering mechanism for traffic engineering with BIER. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: BIER marks which receivers should get a copy. This version instead marks which roads to use, so a sender can plan exactly how the copies spread out.

questions: how does bier traffic engineering work
